title: Uniform BLR and voting tester mixture
statement: For each $n\ge 0$, define a three-query tester by choosing with equal probability between the sign-valued BLR tester and the not-all-equal voting tester on the Boolean cube.
caveat: The exact acceptance rule of the sign BLR tester and the meanings of ranking profiles and pairwise-vote vectors are not supplied.
